D: Deadpool forms a team to protect a young mutant from a time-travelling soldier named Cable.
P: Serve the snacks when X-Force jumps out of the plane.
S: Shredded beef braised with chipotle, rolled with cheddar in small flour tortillas, fried until crisp, with sour cream and salsa.
Spiced potato and pea filling folded in pastry triangles, fried until golden, with tamarind chutney.
the X-Force skydive that goes badly wrong
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with melted butter, chilli flakes, lime zest and salt until coated, poured into paper cones.
M: the mutant prison called the Ice Box
Beef chuck simmered 3 hours with onion, carrot and potato until thick, served in metal bowls with bread.
Steaks seared and butter basted, sliced with chips and a red wine sauce, candles on the table.
W: Cream cheese, sugar and eggs beaten smooth over a biscuit base, baked at 160C for 50 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with a glossy raspberry coulis.
K: Strong cold brew coffee over ice, black, no fuss.

s.how: Braise 800g beef chuck with chopped chipotle and water for 3 hours, then shred. Roll small amounts with grated cheddar in small flour tortillas, folding in the sides. Fry seam side down until crisp all over. Serve with sour cream and chopped tomato salsa.

Boil and crush 600g potatoes with 150g peas and a spoon of garam masala. Cut spring roll pastry into strips, spoon filling at one end and fold into triangles. Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp. Serve with tamarind paste mixed with a little sugar and water.

m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into chips and roast until crisp. Sear 4 sirloin steaks in a very hot pan, add butter and baste for a minute, then rest. Add 150ml red wine and 250ml beef stock to the pan and reduce until glossy. Slice and serve by candlelight.

w.how: Crush 250g sweet biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 500g cream cheese with 150g sugar, then beat in 3 eggs. Pour over and bake at 160C for 50 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with raspberries simmered with sugar and pushed through a sieve.

d.how: Stir 100g coarsely ground coffee into 1L cold water in a jug. Cover and leave in the fridge for 12 hours. Strain through a fine sieve lined with paper. Pour over ice, black and strong, and drink it without making a fuss about it.
